description: Create frontend/src/services/careerService.js and all 10 shared components in frontend/src/components/career/. These are pure presentational/service building blocks that all later FEATs depend on — they must be created first. Independent of FEAT-002, FEAT-003, FEAT-004 in direction: those FEATs import from this one.
steps: Create frontend/src/services/careerService.js. Import { api } from './api'. Export named functions grouped by domain: (skill-evidence) getSkillEvidence()=api.get('/skill-evidence'), getSkillEvidenceBreakdown()=api.get('/skill-evidence/breakdown'), addSkillEvidence(data)=api.post('/skill-evidence',data); (career) getSkillGaps()=api.get('/career/skill-gaps'), getActionPlan()=api.get('/career/action-plan'), updateActionItem(id)=api.patch('/career/action-plan/'+id,{}), getReadiness()=api.get('/career/readiness'), getDigitalTwin()=api.get('/career/digital-twin'), getCareerPaths()=api.get('/career/career-paths'); (outcomes) recordOutcome(data)=api.post('/outcomes',data), getOutcomePatterns()=api.get('/outcomes/patterns'), getInterviewLearning()=api.get('/outcomes/interview-learning'); (certificates) getMyCertificates()=api.get('/certificates/my'), verifyCertificate(id)=api.get('/certificates/verify/'+id), issueCertificate(data)=api.post('/certificates',data), verifyCertificateAdmin(id)=api.put('/certificates/'+id+'/verify',{}), revokeCertificate(id)=api.put('/certificates/'+id+'/revoke',{}), getAllCertificates(params)=api.get('/certificates',{params}); (admin) getCareerInsights()=api.get('/admin/career-insights'); (completion) getPartnerCompletions(params)=api.get('/completion/partner/all',{params}), updateCompletionStatus(id,data)=api.put('/completion/'+id,data); Add default export object with all functions.

Create frontend/src/components/career/ConfidenceBar.jsx. Props: score(0-100), label, showPercent(bool), size('sm'|'md'|'lg'), colorOverride. Color logic: score<30→'bg-red-500', score<60→'bg-amber-500', >=60→'bg-emerald-500'. Height by size: sm→h-1.5, md→h-2.5, lg→h-4. Use motion.div from framer-motion to animate the fill width from 0 to (score+'%') on mount. Show label left + percent right when showPercent. Wrap in a div with optional colorOverride applied to the bar. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/career/SkillEvidenceCard.jsx. Props: skillName, proficiency, confidenceScore, evidenceSources(array of strings), isVerified(bool). Use neo-glass p-4 rounded-xl. Top row: skill name (font-semibold) + proficiency badge (bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full) + verified shield (ShieldCheck from lucide-react, emerald, only if isVerified). ConfidenceBar with score=confidenceScore, label='Confidence', showPercent, size='sm'. Evidence source tags: each in bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md. Hover: whileHover scale 1.01 via motion.div. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/career/SkillGapItem.jsx. Props: rank, skillName, priority('high'|'medium'|'low'), currentConfidence, gapScore, estimatedImpact, learningEffort, reason. Render as a horizontal item: rank badge (circle, saffron bg), skill name (font-semibold), ConfidenceBar for currentConfidence, reason text (text-sm text-gray-600), impact badge (high=red, medium=amber, low=green), effort badge (bg-purple-100 text-purple-700). Use neo-glass p-4 rounded-xl. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/career/InternshipQualityBadge.jsx. Props: qualityScore(0-100), riskLevel('low'|'medium'|'high'), roiEstimate(string). Three compact inline badges: (1) quality score colored by value (>=70 green, >=40 amber, else red), (2) risk level badge (low=green, medium=amber, high=red) with Shield icon, (3) ROI estimate badge (bg-blue-100 text-blue-700). Each badge has a title attribute for tooltip. Wrap in a flex gap-1.5. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/career/ApplicationStrengthBar.jsx. Props: strength(0-100), breakdown({fitScore, evidenceScore, completenessScore}), disclaimer(string). Large strength % display (text-3xl font-black colored: >=70 emerald, >=40 amber, else red). Main ConfidenceBar for strength (size='lg'). Three mini ConfidenceBars with labels for fitScore/evidenceScore/completenessScore. Disclaimer as text-xs text-gray-400 italic below. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/career/TruthGuardAlert.jsx. Props: issues(array of {claim, issue, severity('low'|'medium'|'high')}), onEdit, defaultDismissed(bool). Dismissible banner (state: dismissed). When not dismissed: amber/red border-l-4 bg-amber-50 rounded-xl p-4. AlertTriangle icon from lucide-react. List each issue: severity badge + claim text + issue description. onEdit button (Button variant='outline' size='sm'). Dismiss X button (top right). severity='high' uses red colors, others amber. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/career/ExplainableRecommendationCard.jsx. Props: internship({title, organization}), matchedSkills(array), missingSkills(array), fitScore(0-100), reasons(array of strings), warnings(array of strings). neo-glass p-5. Fit score badge (colored). Title + org. 'Why recommended' section: green CheckCircle2 icon per reason. 'What's missing' section: red/amber XCircle per missing skill. Expandable (useState expanded): show full reasons + warnings when expanded. 'Why not apply?' handled externally via WhyNotApplyModal. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/career/CertificateCard.jsx. Props: certificate({certificateId, organization, role, skills(array), issuedAt, status('active'|'pending'|'revoked'), qrCodeData}). Styled like a certificate: neo-glass p-6 border border-amber-200. Top: Award icon (lucide-react, gold) + org name. Role + issued date. Status badge: active=emerald, pending=amber, revoked=red. Skills as tags. Certificate ID in monospace with Copy button (copy to clipboard, toast 'Copied!'). If status=active and qrCodeData: show qrCodeData in a bordered box labeled 'Verification Data'. react-hot-toast for copy notification. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/career/PassportSection.jsx. Props: title, icon(LucideIcon component), items(array of strings), emptyMessage(string). Section header: icon + title (font-semibold text-gray-700). Items as styled chips: bg-white/70 border border-gray-200 text-sm px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full flex-wrap gap-2. Empty state: EmptyState component from ui/ with the emptyMessage. Wrap in div className='space-y-3'. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/career/WhyNotApplyModal.jsx. Props: isOpen, onClose, internshipTitle, concerns(array of {issue, severity('low'|'medium'|'high'), suggestion}), overallRisk('low'|'medium'|'high'), recommendation(string). Use Modal component from ui/ with title='Why Not Apply?'. AlertTriangle icon. internshipTitle in heading. Concerns list: each concern shows severity badge + issue + suggestion in italic. Overall risk badge (colored). Recommendation box: bg-blue-50 border-blue-200 rounded-xl p-3 text-sm. Close button via Modal's onClose. Default export.

Create frontend/src/components/career/WhatIfSimulator.jsx. Props: onSimulate(async fn that takes skillName and returns {before, after}), skills(array of strings). Dropdown select skill (from skills array, or free-text input). Simulate button (Button variant='primary'). isLoading state while simulating. After result: show 'Before: N opportunities' → 'After: M opportunities' with colored diff (+X more, green if positive). Disclaimer: text-xs text-gray-400 'Estimates based on current platform data'. If no skills prop, show a text input instead. Default export. NOTE: if onSimulate is not provided, show a disabled state.
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/services/careerService.js exists with named exports for all documented functions and a default export object.
All 10 component files exist in frontend/src/components/career/.
Each component file has a default export.
npm run build from frontend/ passes (run after FEAT-004 completes all imports — individual build verification is done at FEAT-004 time).
verification: cd 'd:\my code\my project\NEO GEN INTERNSHIP ENGINE/frontend' && npm run build 2>&1 — run only after FEAT-004 has wired all imports; FEAT-001 alone does not need to be imported to build.
findings: Created careerService.js with 18 named exports (skill-evidence, career, outcomes, certificates, admin, completion groups) plus default export object. Created all 10 career components: ConfidenceBar (framer-motion animated fill, score-based coloring, sm/md/lg sizes), SkillEvidenceCard (ShieldCheck verified badge, evidence source tags), SkillGapItem (rank badge, priority/effort badges), InternshipQualityBadge (quality/risk/ROI inline badges with Shield icon), ApplicationStrengthBar (large % display + 3 mini bars), TruthGuardAlert (dismissible, severity-colored, per-issue list), ExplainableRecommendationCard (expandable reasons/missing/warnings with CheckCircle2/XCircle), CertificateCard (Award icon, copy-to-clipboard with react-hot-toast, QR data box), PassportSection (chip list with EmptyState fallback), WhyNotApplyModal (wraps Modal ui component, concerns list + recommendation box), WhatIfSimulator (select or free-text skill, before/after diff display). All use ES modules, default exports, neo-glass/glass-card styling, lucide-react v0.363.0 compatible icons. No existing files modified.
